task.title: Exporting from a script
task.shortdesc: Enable mod-script-pipe, then normalize and export the open project from a Python script.

prereq.p: Python 3 is installed, and a project is open in .

step.cmd: Choose EditPreferencesModules, set mod-script-pipe to Enabled, and restart .
Save the sample script as export-mp3.py.
Run it, naming the output file.

screen.systemoutput: BatchCommand finished: OK BatchCommand finished: OK BatchCommand finished: OK

steptroubleshooting.p: If the script stops with FileNotFoundError, the pipe does not exist: is not running or the module is not enabled. On Linux, ls /tmp/audacity_script_pipe.* shows whether the pipes are there.

result.p: The project is normalized to -1 dB and exported as mono MP3. Change NumChannels to 2 for stereo.
